goal: Replenish the hotel preparation reserve after the current four hotel publication.
boundaries: Four finite hotel names, active Egypt catalogue and existing two-channel registry only. No provider calls, customer data or changes to monitoring targets.
criteria: Exact active catalogue hotel and resort, clear product identity, no live registry match before adding to reserve. Primary facts and real cover remain separate requirements.
risks: Similar names do not prove identical products. Existing publications or ambiguous identities must be excluded.
